ཐིམ་ཕུག་ས་ཁྲ land parcel cadastral map Bhutan Thimphu official
executedQueries.language: Dzongkha (Tibetan script mixed with English terms)

officialSources.observation: National Spatial Data Infrastructure catalogue lists National Land Commission Secretariat “Cadastral Boundary” as Open and describes cadastral plot shapes.
Metadata names NLCS as publisher; plot boundary is vector cadastral data, 0.10 m resolution, extents include Thimphu, and local surveys were transformed to Drukref03.
Bhutan Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport says Zhichar connects plan boundaries, building stock and land cadastre and validates plot boundaries through NLCS.

Official NLCS Plot Boundary polygon layer. Native fields include fid, originalco, spatialacc, datemodifi, mapsheet, originalpr, plotid, fcode, shape__are and shape__len. Metadata says 238,000 surfaces, 0.10 m resolution, created 2008-06-01, metadata revised 2024-11-07, update frequency as needed; extent includes Thimphu. No personal fields are needed for parcel geometry identity.
tt_taba_plots public municipal plot layer; all 112 qualified polygons lie within the published tt_bdy2010 Thromde boundary. No documented legal, current or planning status.

registryBasis: Public municipal Taba plot records establish city-level land mapping activity. Their legal registration, lifecycle and planning status are undocumented; the original national cadastral sample lies outside the municipal boundary.
